Caplight | caplight.com | Backeind/Fullstack Engineer | Full-time | SF | $225k-$350k + equity

Caplight is a profitable fintech company reimagining the private markets. We build data, trading, research, and workflow tooling for VCs and other private company investors. We're closing a Series A on the back of strong success with our current platform which focuses on helping late-stage VCs track realtime pricing on pre-IPO companies like Anthropic, Stripe, SpaceX, etc. Our goal over the next year is to build powerful agentic workflows to automate large parts of the VC ecosystem.

Looking for product-minded AGI-pilled engineers. If interested, email me with a short description of your background and why you believe you're right for the role: justin at caplight.com (if you write your email with AI I will not read it)
